correctness.rationale: Gale evenness makes every even-dimensional cyclic-polytope facet exactly a k-matching of the label cycle C_n. A minimum transversal is complement Y with induced matching number <=k-1. For proper cycle-induced path unions, alpha(Y)=|Y|-nu(Y) <=floor(n/2), so |Y|<=floor(n/2)+k-1 and equality forces a maximum independent set with k-1 additional vertices. Odd-n cyclic run encoding splits into t=u or t=u+1 and gives n[binom(h-1,r)+binom(h-1,r-1)] = n binom(h,r); even n has two alternating independence sets, each with binom(h,r) choices. Independent enumeration generated facets from literal Gale parity, enumerated all transversals and checked minimum families for n=3..11 and all admissible k. All-parameter proof is structural, not inferred from tests.
